# puff decoder

Unmodified puff 2.3 by Mark Adler, from the zlib v1.3.1 source distribution:

- [puff.c](https://github.com/madler/zlib/blob/v1.3.1/contrib/puff/puff.c), SHA256 `5b9d75aeb5baf3575415bc6ade3f2a02e50b6b971b3f8b4fda2b03543bc6e52f`
- [puff.h](https://github.com/madler/zlib/blob/v1.3.1/contrib/puff/puff.h), SHA256 `969b7be2a930db0cdcb19b0e5b29ae6741f5a8f663b6dba6d647e12ec60cfa8e`

The original license is retained in `puff.h` and distributed with native packs.
Only the native desktop target links this decoder; web HD support is deferred.
